MINISTRY OF WORKS & FAMILY ISLAND AFFAIRS
DEPARTMENT OF PHYSICAL PLANNING
PUBLIC HEARING NOTICE
SAMPSON CAY BAHAMAS LIMITED - PROPOSED SITE PLAN
APPLICATION - SAMPSON CAY, EXUMA
The public is hereby advised that a previous public notice issued and publicized, in
the newspapers, by the Department, contained an error in the year only.
Please note the correct year is 2026, and not 2025 as previously stated. The day,
month, and time remain the same as outlined in the original notice. All other
information contained therein remains unchanged.
The Department regrets any inconvenience or confusion this error may have caused
and thanks the public for its understanding.
The public is hereby notified a Site Plan Application (SPA/7/2025) on behalf of
Sampson Cay Bahamas Limited is presently being reviewed by the Department of
Physical Planning for presentation to the Town Planning Committee.
The applicant is proposing to develop a 131.3-acre portion of Sampson Cay, in the
Exumas, for a resort development. The applicants propose a resort, residential lots,
a marina, restaurants, a beach club and other amenities on the site.
The public hearing will be held on Thursday, 5th February, 2025 at 6:00 p.m.,
at the Black Point Exuma All-age School; with an additional hearing to be held
on Friday, 20th February, 2026 at 6:00 p.m. at the L.N. Coakley High School,
Exuma, for all interested parties to discuss and address planning issues related to
the proposed resort development.

Preliminary plans for the proposed development may be viewed at the Department
of Physical Planning, Aventura Plaza, John F. Kennedy Drive, and at the Local
Administrator’s Office in Exuma during working hours.
Signed
Jehan Wallace
Acting Director of Physical Planning
